$meta.method: Headless browser driven at Google Maps place search, scoped to a district viewport per query, results panel auto-scrolled to exhaustion and the result cards read out of the DOM.
$meta.why_this_is_different: The travel web (blogs, listicles, OTA pages) only covers Imphal and a handful of headline sights. Maps carries the businesses local people actually review. This pass closed three of the four gaps flagged in README.md — eateries outside Imphal, two-wheeler rental, and Loktak stays — and turned up ~35 places that appear in neither the existing hotspot seed nor places.json.

field_notes.rating_reviews: Google rating and review count as displayed on 2026-09-23. Review count is the better signal of whether a business is real and active — a 4.9 with 3 reviews means much less than a 4.0 with 992.
field_notes.price_band: Google's own ₹ band, not a menu price.
field_notes.address: As displayed on the card. Strings like '8MJV+9FM' are Google Plus Codes — resolvable to exact coordinates.
field_notes.phone: Only present where the card displayed one.
field_notes.verification: All of this is Google-listed but NOT phone-verified by us. Same rule as the rest of the dataset: call before publishing.

new_stays.note: Additions and corrections to stays.json. The Loktak floating-stay cluster is the headline: three operators, all with real review volume, none of which the travel web surfaces properly.

loktak_floating_stays.name: LOKTAK AQUAMARINE FLOATING HOMESTAY & CAMPSITE
loktak_floating_stays.address: Takmu, Loktak Lake, near Omba Nurathel Garden
loktak_floating_stays.resolves: This is almost certainly the 'Loktak Aquamarine Homestay' registered with Manipur Tourism (owner Ashok Sapamcha, +91 80149 21286). Maps shows it is a floating homestay AND campsite at Takmu — considerably more than the official page conveys. 207 reviews makes it the most-reviewed homestay in the state.
loktak_floating_stays.review_signal: Great people, very special place, delicious food — with one recurring note that it is a little overpriced.

remaining_gaps: Thoubal, Kakching, Tamenglong, Noney, Chandel, Moreh and Jiribam were not swept — same method will work, one viewport per district.

Maps cards do not expose email, and expose a phone only sometimes. Opening a place's detail panel would yield phone, website, full address and the hours grid for every record — a second pass, ~1 navigation per place.
Exact coordinates were not captured. Every Plus Code in this file resolves to a precise point, and each place's URL carries its lat/lng — a cheap follow-up that would let you drop real map pins.
Still nothing on shared-Sumo / inter-district hill services, which do not appear on Maps as businesses.
